## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector performance (Utilities, Consumer Staples, Energy, Real Estate, Materials positive vs Technology, Financials, Communication weak) and Major Divergence among mega-caps (NVDA (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +4.17%) TREND EXHAUSTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.97% | 1M: +8.52%) TREND EXHAUSTION, AMZN (1W: -6.28% | 1M: +4.40%) TREND EXHAUSTION) suppress strong regime calls; Leadership: Broad (Top 5 from 4 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: EXC (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +1.65%) ABOVE TREND, D (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +1.63%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: MDLZ (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +8.74%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +4.46% | 1M: -1.61%) RECOVERY. Energy showing strength: XOM (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +10.55%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology weak: AAPL (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND, broad software names down. Financials soft: JPM (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -6.40%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure: CHTR (1W: -10.87% | 1M: -12.14%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +10.21% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND; CME (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +2.25%) ABOVE TREND; MDLZ (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +8.74%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +19.60%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MMM (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -3.73%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -6.40%) BELOW TREND; QCOM (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -10.60%) BELOW TREND; CHTR (1W: -10.87% | 1M: -12.14%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology and pockets of Financials/Comm.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.21% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +2.25%) ABOVE TREND — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: NVDA (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +4.17%) TREND EXHAUSTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.97% | 1M: +8.52%) TREND EXHAUSTION, AMZN (1W: -6.28% | 1M: +4.40%) TREND EXHAUSTION — tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed-to-weak with sector 1W: -4.70% (19 stocks) and many large-cap software names BELOW TREND; chipmakers are outperforming: AMD (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.21% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND, while NVDA (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +4.17%) TREND EXHAUSTION and several software names (ADBE (1W: -11.38% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -19.86%) BELOW TREND) show material downside.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials uneven and soft 1W: -2.26% (20 stocks) with pockets of strength: CME (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +2.25%) ABOVE TREND and bullish headlines for GS, AIG, V, but majors are under pressure: JPM (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -6.40%) BELOW TREND — style: mixed / no clear leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare drifting; defensive JNJ (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +3.75%) ABOVE TREND while ISRG (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: -0.73% (15 stocks) and tone is mixed between defensives and biotech/medtech weakness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selectively: Energy and Materials exposure (XOM (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +19.60%) ABOVE TREND) and defensive Utilities/Staples exposure; reduce exposure to high-multiple software names showing trend breaks (ADBE (1W: -11.38% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -19.86%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -15.16% | 1M: -14.61%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given chip strength but broad tech weakness.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.21% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -11.38% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -15.16% | 1M: -14.61%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -16.76% | 1M: -19.80%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +1.63%, 8 stocks), Materials (1W: +0.08%, 7 stocks), Utilities (1W: +3.24%, 6 stocks) — watch follow-through on commodity/utility strength. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.70%, 19 stocks), Financials (1W: -2.26%, 20 stocks), Communication (1W: -3.94%, 7 stocks).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +4.17%) TREND EXHAUSTION — failure to reclaim monthly uptrend would signal renewed risk for chip rally. AAPL (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND — further weekly follow-through below recent lows would widen large-cap tech leadership gap. XOM (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly strength confirms commodity-driven leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LMT (+70): LMT (1W: +4.50% | 1M: +21.33%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price and guidance optimism. INTC (+50): INTC (1W: +10.21% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND — upgrades confirmed by strong momentum. AAPL (+50): AAPL (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND — Citi foldable iPhone headline is diverging from price, watch for distribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (-50): INTU (1W: -16.76% | 1M: -19.80%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned; downside risk elevated. MA (-50): MA (1W: -6.10% | 1M: -5.82%) BELOW TREND — news-driven weakness confirming price. (Note: broader bearish headlines on SCHW/MA/INTU add downside risk to Financials.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style (Style: mixed / no clear leadership). AMD (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.21% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among mega-caps (NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN TREND EXHAUSTION vs AAPL/MSFT/META BELOW TREND) and several news-price divergences (AAPL positive headlines but price BELOW TREND).
